Wonder Boys streaming: where to watch online?

You can buy "Wonder Boys" on Amazon Video, Apple TV, Fandango At Home as download or rent it on Amazon Video, Apple TV, Fandango At Home online.

Besides streaming, you can also buy the movie on DVD from Barnes & Noble and on Blu-ray from Barnes & Noble.

You can also stream the title for free on Kanopy, Hoopla.

Synopsis

Grady is a 50-ish English professor who hasn't had a thing published in years—not since he wrote his award winning 'Great American Novel' 7 years ago. This weekend proves even worse than he could imagine as he finds himself reeling from one misadventure to another in the company of a new wonder boy author.
